story_zh: 今天是中秋节，月亮很圆。小明收到一个特别的礼物——照相机。他拍了一张熊猫的照片，画了一只鸟和一匹马。晚上，他骑自行车去看电影，节目很精彩。回家后，他安静地读故事书，声音很轻。欢迎来到娱乐的世界！
story_pinyin: Jīntiān shì Zhōngqiū Jié, yuèliang hěn yuán. Xiǎo Míng shōudào yīgè tèbié de lǐwù——zhàoxiàngjī. Tā pāi le yī zhāng xióngmāo de zhàopiàn, huà le yī zhī niǎo hé yī pǐ mǎ. Wǎnshàng, tā qí zìxíngchē qù kàn diànyǐng, jiémù hěn jīngcǎi. Huí jiā hòu, tā ānjìng de dú gùshì shū, shēngyīn hěn qīng. Huānyíng lái dào yúlè de shìjiè!
story_en: Today is Mid-Autumn Festival, and the moon is very round. Xiao Ming receives a special gift—a camera. He takes a photo of a panda and draws a bird and a horse. In the evening, he rides his bicycle to watch a movie, and the program is wonderful. After returning home, he quietly reads a storybook with a soft voice. Welcome to the world of entertainment!
